title: pm-eng 1:1 prep - Evelyn Park
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Marcus Lee (eng lead)
Date: 2025-03-03 10:00am PT
Location: Zoom (link in calendar)
Goal: align on near-term priorities across API, Console, Dedicated, Private; unblock decisions for Q2 roadmap; sync on stability work and capacity planning.

Agenda (prioritized):
- Quick sync (5m) — personal check-in, bandwidth
- API hosted: rollout status + perf regression analysis (15m)
  - Recent perf spike after kernel change on 2/20; need patch roll-forward or rollback decision.
  - Metrics I care about: p50/p95 latency, token cost, error rate by model family.
  - Ask: can we get a short RCA draft by EOD Thu? If not, what's the mitigation plan?
- Console/rollouts: canary flow simplification (10m)
  - Product wants a lower-friction canary for small customers (toggle via Console).
  - Discuss feasibility of a safe default (traffic % slider + automated fallback) and estimated implementation effort.
- Dedicated capacity: autoscaling thresholds + SLA language (10m)
  - Customer asks for clearer autoscale guarantees for commit tiers. Need engineering input on safe promises.
  - Ask: propose two SLA options we can offer (conservative + aggressive) with supporting notes.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): onboarding checklist + KMS/HSM integration status (8m)
  - Security asked about HSM integration timeline. Last update was "in design".
  - Ask: give me a short checklist of remaining tasks and estimated ship dates.
- Blockers & risks (7m)
  - Capacity constraints for burst workloads in eu-west-1 (impacting 2x customers).
  - Regression risk when we flip new batching policy.
- Action items & follow-ups (5m)

Prep notes / current status (raw):
- API hosted perf regression: we saw p95 jump ~22% for long context (>2k) requests after CUDA kernel update. Error rates unchanged but latency SLO breached for a set of customers. Infra pointed to kernel selection change (INF-342). Marcus mentioned a potential micro-optimization to KV cache handling that could bring p95 back. Need cost/benefit estimate.
- Console canary UX: PM-design proposed a simple slider + safety net. Eng estimates: ~3-5 dev days + e2e tests + rollout monitor. Open question: does rollout need to be tied to model variants (yes, ideally).
- Dedicated autoscale: current impl uses GPU pool thresholds; it doesn't account for tail latency. We should add a soft floor for tail latency and a queue length metric. Engineering: need to validate whether current autoscaler can use queue-length signal without destabilizing pools.
- Private/KMS: security team requires a running HSM prototype with at-rest key rotation. Engineering has PoC using vendor X but missing integration tests and deployment scripts.

Decisions I need in this 1:1:
- Roll forward micro-optimization patch vs rollback kernel change? (trade-offs: short-term rollback vs longer-term perf gain)
- Can we commit to a "conservative" autoscale SLA for Dedicated by end of Q2? What would that look like?
- Timeline for HSM/KMS integration (realistic vs optimistic dates)

Open questions / notes to self:
- Ask Marcus if infra can provide an isolated perf run (no caching) to repro kernel impact. If not, escalate to SRE.
- Confirm whether canary slider can be restricted by customer tier to avoid misuse.
- Check with legal if the conservative SLA language needs further review before external comms.

Metrics / links I'm watching before the meeting:
- Perf dashboard: p50/p95 by model + sequence length (link in Confluence)
- Error logs: /ops/alerts (search INF-REGRESSION-2025-02-20)
- Dedicated capacity report: monthly-commit-usage sheet

Proposed action items (to assign in meeting):
- Marcus: short RCA draft for perf regression (due 2025-03-06)
- Liam: run isolated perf repro for long-context requests (start 2025-03-04)
- Riya: mockup of canary slider in Console + UX copy (due 2025-03-10)
- Evelyn (me): draft conservative autoscale SLA bullets and send to legal for quick review (due 2025-03-07)
- Marcus + Infra: list of remaining tasks for HSM integration and estimated dates (due 2025-03-12)

Follow-up plan after meeting:
- Capture decisions in Confluence page (I'll update) + link in customer-facing KB if SLA agreed.
- Create a short status email to PMs and sales if rollback is chosen.
- Book a 30m follow-up next week to review RCA and actions.

Loose thoughts / brainstorm (notes-to-self):
- Could we expose a "safe mode" in Console that automatically reduces batch sizes for latency-sensitive customers? Might be a quick tactical win.
- Consider a beta for Dedicated customers to opt into queue-length-based autoscale and share metrics back with product (data-sharing incentive).

Todo before meeting (quick list):
- skim INF-342 thread and latest kernel PR (PR 1287)
- pull latest p95 numbers for model families (post-2/20)
- confirm Marcus's availability and set meeting agenda in invite

Rough draft email I might send after meeting (template):
"Hi all — quick recap from 1:1 with Marcus: we decided to X. Action owners: A: by date, B: by date. Next check-in: 2025-03-10. Let me know if I missed anything."

Random notes / friction points I've seen:
- eng triage loop sometimes lacks clear ownership between infra and serving-runtime for perf regressions -> propose a playbook snippet in Confluence.
- Console rollout config lives in two places (frontend + infra) which makes small changes annoying; we should aim to consolidate to single source of truth (config service).

End of prep notes.
